title.rendered: Board Work Session: Local Option and General Obligation Bonds Presentation

content.rendered: On Wednesday, January 4, the Sherwood School District Board of Directors participated in a special work session on the topic of local option and general obligation bonds. To review the information from that work session, please see the links below.
